comparison.objective: Flex a spring-steel build plate to release a printed part without permanently kinking the plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Symmetric bimanual elastic bending, part release, plate recovery, and subsequent part placement.
comparison.success_condition: Part freed and binned, plate returned flat, hands clear, with no excessive curvature, drop, or unsafe displacement.
comparison.reason: PR-1949 tests controlled elastic deformation to break adhesion. The candidate uses rigid screen orientation and agitation to sort free bodies by aperture compatibility; bimanual load sharing alone does not establish overlap.
